import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Check logs
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -20 /var/log/areloria/out-0.log 2>&1")
print("Logs:", stdout.read().decode())
# Check PM2 status
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 list")
print("\nPM2:", stdout.read().decode())
time.sleep(3)
# Check again after wait
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 list 2>&1")
print("\nPM2 after:", stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
EOF
